instances.spoken_text: Invest sixty-five thousand dollars now. Discount at twenty percent. What equal annual cash receipt over the next three years gives zero NPV, in thousands of dollars?

follow_up.question: How would a positive residual value at the end change the required annual cash flow?
follow_up.reference: Its discounted value would cover part of the initial outlay. The annual operating cash flow required for zero NPV would therefore fall, assuming the residual receipt is additional and does not change other cash flows.
